tools.name: ask_site
tools.description: Read-only search of Network Thinking Solutions services, locations, and knowledge-base guidance. Returns matching excerpts and source URLs without navigating, changing page state, or submitting a form.

tools.name: browse_services
tools.description: Read-only lookup of Network Thinking Solutions services and industry offerings for a business need. Returns matching offerings and URLs without navigating or changing page state.

tools.name: calculate_m365_quote
tools.description: Read-only Microsoft 365 planning estimate using current U.S. list prices and catalog SKU IDs. Returns priced line items, validation guidance, totals, and a shareable calculator URL without navigating, purchasing, or submitting a quote.

tools.name: defang_or_refang_url
tools.description: Read-only local text transformation between clickable URLs or domains and safely defanged hxxp and [.] notation. Returns transformed text without navigating, fetching the URL, or changing page state.

tools.name: format_route53_dkim_record
tools.description: Read-only local formatting of a DKIM public key into quoted Route 53 TXT-record segments within DNS length limits. Returns the formatted value and chunks without connecting to Route 53 or modifying DNS.

tools.name: navigate_to_service
tools.description: Navigate the visible website to the strongest Network Thinking Solutions service match for a business need. Changes only the current page and does not submit a form or create a commitment.

tools.name: open_m365_calculator
tools.description: Open a calculator URL returned by calculate_m365_quote in the visible website. Navigates the current page but does not purchase licenses, capture a lead, or submit a firm quote.
